scope: Preserve an existing SQLite STRICT ANY cell's INTEGER, REAL or TEXT runtime storage class when edited through the app grid parser and keyed-update path.
For a NULL or newly inserted cell, empty input follows the shared nullable-column rule and stores NULL; nonempty input remains TEXT rather than guessing a storage class.
A BLOB runtime value in SQLite STRICT ANY is refused by the shared inline-editability gate and retains its exact bytes.
